nodes.title: Supported Protocols
nodes.summary: - OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE: RFC 7636 compliant authorization flow for web and mobile clients. - Client Credentials Grant: RFC 6749 flow for machine-to-machine service communication.

nodes.title: Security Boundaries
nodes.summary: All access tokens are minted as RS256 signed JWTs with a strict 15-minute lifetime. Refresh tokens are opaque 256-bit cryptographically secure random tokens stored in Redis with rotating replay detection.

nodes.title: System Context & Peer Services
nodes.summary: This repository operates as the centralized identity provider within the Checkout & Identity Mesh. - System Topology: View full distributed interaction flows in the Checkout & Identity Mesh Architecture.

nodes.title: Asymmetric Key Rotation
nodes.summary: Tokens are signed using RS256 private keys managed in Kubernetes secrets. Public keys are exported via standard JWKS (/.well-known/jwks.json) with automated kid rotation every 30 days.

nodes.title: Token Revocation & Blocklist
nodes.summary: While JWT access tokens are stateless, immediate revocation (e.g. on compromised credentials or password reset) is handled via a low-latency Redis bloom filter combined with a hot revocation set keyed by sub and jti.

nodes.title: Protocol Conventions
nodes.summary: - Content-Type: application/json - Encoding: UTF-8 - Authentication: Bearer tokens or API keys via Authorization header.
